pricingReview.findings: Compared the published Standard rates for GPT-6 Luna, GPT-6.2, GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst, Gemini 3.8 Flash and Nano Banana 2.1 with the app and manual values. Reviewed separate Batch rates and the scheduled January increase for Gemini 3.8 Flash.

apiValidation.scope: Normal browser UI with GPT-6 Luna, fallback disabled. STEP3 received HTTP 200 once, produced a 18,677-character prompt and preserved all five cameras, three spoken lines and the named P3 silent foreground actor. STEP2 generated four panels with two registered actors and a named guest without a sheet. Both requests returned HTTP 200 and cast/payoff review passed without regeneration. Replayed three original STEP3 diagnostic responses on the corrected parser.
